name: Direct Gaussian Splatting
aliases: direct conditional parameterization for Gaussian kernel
definition: A direct conditional parameterization for N-dimensional splatting using a Gaussian kernel. It replaces the covariance-derived readout (requiring matrix inversions and regression products) with explicit per-effect parameters: a Cholesky precision factor for opacity and a factorized query-to-position regression operator with learnable per-dimension coupling.
summary: Direct Gaussian Splatting is an N-dimensional splatting method that replaces covariance-derived conditioning with explicit per-primitive parameters, eliminating expensive matrix inversions and separating position and opacity effects.
